chains.title: FOXA1 binds the alt T allele more and activates a TOX3 enhancer

links.claim: FOXA1 binds the alt T allele more strongly than ref C. FOXA1 is chosen from prior 16q12.1 breast-cancer literature; no ChIP, expression, or QBiC-SELEX evidence was supplied for this case, and FOXA1 has no QBiC-SELEX model/evidence here.
rs4784227 lies in a FOXA1-bound regulatory element/enhancer; the T allele creates a stronger FOXA1 site.
The FOXA1-bound enhancer increases TOX3 expression.
The effect occurs in MCF7 mammary epithelial cells, the supplied expression context.
Higher TOX3 expression increases breast cancer risk at 16q12.

predictions: Allele-specific FOXA1 ChIP in MCF7 shows higher FOXA1 occupancy on T than C at rs4784227.
A C-vs-T enhancer reporter in MCF7 shows higher activity for T.
TOX3 expression is higher with the T allele in MCF7/breast models.
The T allele is associated with increased breast cancer risk.
falsified_if: FOXA1 ChIP is not higher on T than C.
The T allele does not increase enhancer reporter activity.
TOX3 expression is not higher with T.

chains.title: FOXA1 binds the ref C allele more and represses TOX3; T loses repression

links.claim: FOXA1 binds the ref C allele more strongly than alt T. FOXA1 is chosen as the same locus candidate; no ChIP, expression, or QBiC-SELEX evidence was supplied, and FOXA1 has no QBiC-SELEX model/evidence here.
rs4784227 lies in a FOXA1-bound silencer/repressive element; the C allele creates a stronger FOXA1 site.
FOXA1 represses TOX3; loss of the C-allele site on T increases TOX3 expression.
The repressive FOXA1 effect occurs in MCF7 mammary epithelial cells.
Derepressed TOX3 increases breast cancer risk at 16q12.

predictions: Allele-specific FOXA1 ChIP in MCF7 shows higher FOXA1 occupancy on C than T.
A C-vs-T enhancer reporter shows lower activity for C if FOXA1 is repressive.
TOX3 expression is higher with T because the repressive C site is lost.
The T allele is associated with increased breast cancer risk.
falsified_if: FOXA1 ChIP is higher on T than C or shows no allelic difference.
The C allele does not repress enhancer reporter activity.
TOX3 expression is not higher with T.

chains.title: Null: no TF-mediated effect of rs4784227
predictions: No allele-specific TF ChIP difference at rs4784227.
No C-vs-T enhancer reporter difference in MCF7.
TOX3 expression is not associated with rs4784227 after controlling for linked variants.
The 16q12 risk signal is driven by a linked causal variant or another mechanism.
falsified_if: A reproducible allele-specific TF occupancy and enhancer/reporter effect is shown for rs4784227.
TOX3 expression tracks rs4784227 independently of linked variants.

chains.title: GATA3 binds the alt T allele more and activates TOX3

links.claim: GATA3 binds the alt T allele more strongly than ref C. GATA3 is a competing breast-lineage TF; no ChIP, expression, or QBiC-SELEX evidence was supplied, and GATA3 has no QBiC-SELEX model/evidence here.
rs4784227 lies in a GATA3-bound enhancer; the T allele creates a stronger GATA3 site.
The GATA3-bound enhancer increases TOX3 expression.
The effect occurs in MCF7 mammary epithelial cells.
Higher TOX3 expression increases breast cancer risk at 16q12.

predictions: Allele-specific GATA3 ChIP in MCF7 shows higher GATA3 occupancy on T than C.
FOXA1 ChIP shows no allele-specific difference at rs4784227.
GATA3 knockdown reduces T-allele enhancer reporter activity.
The T allele is associated with increased breast cancer risk.
falsified_if: GATA3 ChIP is not higher on T than C.
GATA3 knockdown does not affect the T-allele reporter.
FOXA1, not GATA3, shows allele-specific occupancy.

outcomes.outcome: T probe shifts more than C

outcomes.outcome: T allele higher TOX3 due to loss of repression
